description: React component for date and time input with timezone support, including manual entry, dropdown selection, and date picker integration.

methods.name: getRoundedTime
methods.description: Rounds a Moment object to the nearest specified interval in minutes, default 30 minutes.

methods.name: getTimeInIntervals
methods.description: Generates an array of Moment objects representing time intervals within a day, accounting for DST changes.

methods.name: parseTimeString
methods.description: Parses a time string supporting various formats (e.g., HH:MM, 12am, 14:30) into hours and minutes.
